tool_args.rationale: The measured response rises concavely with current input and decreases with sink gradient. Fit two compact sink-inhibited logarithmic forms numerically and select by training residual; fresh confirmation must determine whether either generalizes. The fixed horizon and initial-state variables leave their effects unidentified.

considered_alternatives.option: Newton cooling and quartic radiative loss
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Their stated snapshot laws do not account for the observed strong sink-gradient dependence and concave input response.
The available targeted batches have already been acquired; the supplied rows support fitting the observed input and gradient response before fresh confirmation.
It does not discriminate the relevant transfer mechanism.
